failure_pattern_attacked: Run-10 made provider+host proof renewal atomic in the filesystem, but a locally valid renewal could still race a moving origin/main, two renewals could overlap, and durable provider state did not bind the renewed proof payload to committed Git object identities.

source_classification.verbatim_source: Operator governing phrases above and the run-10 next_executable_frontier in LATEST.json
source_classification.verified_provider_state: GitHub main, exact commits, Git trees/blobs, Buildkite status readback
source_classification.verified_host_state: KcBs-MacBook-Air.local real ~/bin/skills proof refresh during live transaction
source_classification.inference: A self-referential final commit SHA cannot be embedded in the same commit; therefore commit-aware proof uses a payload commit plus a finalization commit published by one leased ref update.
contradictions_or_counterevidence: The first synthetic commit-finalization test failed because its bare remote lived inside the synthetic worktree; the clean-tree guard correctly rejected that fixture. The guard was preserved and the fixture was fixed.
The first source-promotion push attempt failed because the shell refspec interpolated incorrectly. Provider main remained unchanged; origin/main was reread before a corrected compare-and-swap retry.

An initial finalizer design rechecked the full recovery tuple after legitimate proof-digest mutation and would have rejected its own renewal. Mission identity and renewable proof identity were split before promotion.

implementation.optimistic_concurrency: snapshot local HEAD, origin/main, mission tuple, and full recovery tuple; fail closed if origin/main or bound state moves
implementation.publish_contract: two local commits, one force-with-lease ref update against the exact captured origin/main

verification.live_transaction: RENEWED; both proof lanes changed; run_sequence and frontier unchanged

objective_state_delta.before: Proof renewal was atomic only across local proof files; concurrent provider movement, overlapping renewals, and uncommitted-but-valid local renewal remained possible ambiguity.
objective_state_delta.after: Proof renewal is serialized per repository, snapshots provider and recovery state, refuses stale promotion, binds renewed provider/host bytes to a payload Git commit/tree/blob set, and publishes payload+finalization through one compare-and-swap provider ref update verified green in Buildkite.

unresolved: The continuity validator does not yet independently traverse and prove the latest renewal receipt's payload commit/tree/blob chain from LATEST.json.
If provider publication is rejected after local payload/finalization commits exist, the worktree remains safely unpublished but recovery of those abandoned local commits is not yet automated.
The finalization commit cannot cryptographically self-name its own SHA; provider readback must remain the authoritative proof that the finalization commit became main.
next_executable_frontier: Extend validate_deep_progress_latest.py to verify the latest proof-renewal Git chain end-to-end: receipt digest, recorded origin parent, payload commit parent/tree, provider+host blob identities, finalization commit ancestry/provider readback, and explicit abandoned-local-transaction recovery when a leased publish is rejected.
